issues.issue: The Local line is fully explained by the p2 program receipts and general receipts, which add up to it exactly. The county rule sends Local lines to their p2 components, and none is over half, so splitting with split_from (Charges for services, Capital grants, Interest Income, other) looks possible. It is left as other with a review note because p2 doesn't label these as the Local line. Judgment call.

The debt fund's 50,000 Local receipt exactly equals its 38,820 principal + 11,180 interest. It may be a contribution or reimbursement toward the shop building debt rather than miscellaneous revenue. Unexplained on the page, so it is kept as other with review.

The Road Fund schedule prints one disbursement total. Per p4 it holds public works 708,080 + capital outlay 55,630 + principal 31,345 + interest 2,955, so the whole line in streets/highways includes capital outlay and debt service. Recorded as printed; flagged for awareness.
